name: Golden Chapter
description: Yellow garden roses, golden freesia and white snapdragons in an uplifting medium bouquet. Bright, elegant and optimistic, celebrating a graduation, a hard-earned diploma or the beginning of a new career.

name: The Commencement Edit
description: Cream roses, blue delphinium and silver-green eucalyptus in a clean, tall arrangement. Confident, fresh and celebratory. A refined graduation gift for someone who prefers cool colors and an architectural silhouette.

name: A Proud Moment
description: Coral peonies, apricot ranunculus and golden accents gathered into a generous hand-tied bouquet. Warm, joyful and expressive. A proud family's congratulations on a graduation or an important academic achievement.

name: Warm Abundance
description: Lush peach garden roses, copper dahlias, amber chrysanthemums and generous soft foliage. Richly layered, warm and abundant in a large rounded bouquet. For someone who wants an enveloping, autumn-toned floral gesture.

name: Honey Garden
description: Butter-yellow roses, creamy stock and apricot sweet peas gathered loosely with garden greenery. Fragrant, lush and welcoming, with warm honey colors. A generous host gift for a relaxed dinner at home.

name: Terracotta Bloom
description: Terracotta carnations, bronze orchids and rust-colored chrysanthemums in a sculptural low composition. Earthy, warm and contemporary. For a design lover who enjoys pottery, textured interiors and unusual muted colors.

name: The Quiet Promotion
description: White roses, green anthurium and crisp eucalyptus arranged with clean lines. Polished, understated and professional. A congratulations bouquet for a promotion, a successful project or a new role at work.

name: Opening Night
description: Deep crimson dahlias, purple orchids and dark sculptural foliage in an asymmetric display. Dramatic, artistic and theatrical. For a performance opening, a gallery exhibition or celebrating a creative achievement.

name: A Scholar's Garden
description: Purple iris, white lisianthus and pale blue flowers in an airy, thoughtful bouquet. Intelligent, calm and quietly celebratory. For finishing a thesis, passing an important exam or thanking a favorite teacher.

name: Apricot Affection
description: Apricot roses, warm cream ranunculus and soft peach sweet peas in a rounded petite bouquet. Tender, intimate and lightly fragrant. A small romantic surprise for someone who loves gentle warm colors.

name: A Mother's Morning
description: Blush peonies, cream garden roses and fragrant pink stock in a generous soft bouquet. Affectionate, lush and comforting. A thoughtful Mother's Day gesture or a warm thank-you for a caring parent.

name: Father's Green Study
description: Green cymbidium orchids, eucalyptus and broad tropical leaves in a compact architectural arrangement. Strong, understated and refreshing. A Father's Day gift for someone who prefers greenery and interesting textures.

name: New Keys
description: White tulips, yellow freesia and light fresh greenery in a cheerful medium bouquet. Airy, optimistic and easygoing. A housewarming gift celebrating new keys, a fresh apartment or a first home.

name: Restful Afternoon
description: Pale lavender lisianthus, cream roses and soft green stems with a loose, soothing silhouette. Gentle, quiet and reassuring. A supportive get-well gesture for someone resting at home, without dramatic bright colors.

name: A Small Apology
description: Soft white ranunculus, pale pink freesia and modest garden greenery in a petite posy. Sincere, gentle and unshowy. For a thoughtful apology or a quiet attempt to reconnect rather than a grand romantic statement.

name: The Long Friendship
description: Peach dahlias, coral roses and small yellow daisies in a warm, informal hand-tied bouquet. Cheerful, familiar and generous. For an old friend's birthday or celebrating years of shared memories.

name: Ruby Jubilee
description: Rich red garden roses, burgundy peonies and polished deep green leaves in a substantial rounded arrangement. Romantic, dignified and luxurious. For a ruby anniversary or a long marriage worth celebrating.

name: Silver Promise
description: Ivory roses, white orchids and silvery eucalyptus in an elegant medium composition. Luminous, serene and refined. A silver-anniversary gesture for someone who loves a restrained white and silver palette.

name: The Engagement Garden
description: Pale pink peonies, peach roses and airy white sweet peas in a lush open bouquet. Tender, joyous and romantic. For an engagement celebration or congratulating a couple on a happy new promise.

name: A Wedding Morning
description: Ivory ranunculus, cream roses and delicate white jasmine in a small graceful arrangement. Soft, fragrant and intimate. A wedding-day gift for the couple, presented as a sample composition rather than a bridal-service offer.

name: An Easter Table
description: Yellow daffodils, white tulips and fresh spring branches in a light medium bouquet. Sunny, seasonal and welcoming. For an Easter gathering or a spring lunch around a bright family table.

name: A Harvest Supper
description: Copper dahlias, amber roses and russet foliage arranged low and generously. Lush, warm and earthy. A sample centerpiece for a harvest dinner, an autumn reunion or a welcoming Thanksgiving table.

name: Evergreen Noel
description: White roses, red berries and rich evergreen branches in a compact seasonal arrangement. Classic, warm and festive. A winter-holiday host gift with restrained red accents and textured green foliage.

name: Midnight Celebration
description: White orchids, cream roses and dark glossy leaves in a tall, striking arrangement. Formal, celebratory and dramatic. For a New Year's gathering or an elegant evening milestone in a monochrome palette.

name: A Valentine in Blush
description: Pale pink garden roses, mauve ranunculus and soft cream accents in a rounded romantic bouquet. Tender, graceful and affectionate. A Valentine's Day gesture for someone who prefers blush tones to traditional red roses.

name: The Red Letter
description: Red tulips, scarlet anemones and crisp green stems in a clean contemporary bouquet. Bold, sincere and romantic without formal rose styling. For Valentine's Day or an affectionate message to a modern-design lover.

name: An Iris Morning
description: Purple iris, blue hyacinth and delicate white flowers in a small spring posy. Cool, fragrant and quietly expressive. A birthday gift for someone who loves purple petals, garden bulbs and soft seasonal perfume.

name: White Fragrance
description: White freesia, jasmine and cream stock with a little clean greenery. Delicate, aromatic and luminous in a medium hand-tied bouquet. For someone who requests fragrant flowers in a restrained all-white palette.

name: The Freesia Note
description: Yellow freesia, pale apricot roses and rosemary in a petite informal bouquet. Lightly fragrant, friendly and sunny. A modest thank-you for a neighbor or a small gesture for someone who enjoys aromatic stems.

name: Jasmine Dusk
description: White jasmine, dusky mauve roses and dark green foliage in a low poetic composition. Fragrant, intimate and softly romantic. An evening gift for someone drawn to gentle perfume and muted vintage colors.

name: A Peony Birthday
description: Large coral peonies, pink garden roses and generous leafy stems in a lush birthday bouquet. Abundant, joyful and expressive. For someone who loves peonies, warm pink colors and a substantial celebratory gesture.

name: A Tulip Sketch
description: White and pale pink tulips gathered simply with their own clean green leaves. Minimal, fresh and modest in scale. A low-key birthday or a just-because gift for someone who prefers simple spring flowers.

name: Dahlia Atelier
description: Wine dahlias, dusty rose flowers and expressive branches in an asymmetric sculptural bouquet. Rich, textured and artistic. For a photographer, designer or creative friend who enjoys unusual shapes and deep colors.

name: Hydrangea Cloud
description: Pale blue hydrangea, ivory roses and airy white accents in a full rounded composition. Soft, cool and cloudlike. For a substantial housewarming gift or someone who wants a generous pastel-blue bouquet.

name: Calla in Cream
description: Cream calla lilies with a few smooth dark leaves in a tall, spare arrangement. Sculptural, elegant and minimalist. A sample design for a modern interior or a recipient who likes architectural white flowers.

name: Tropical Coral
description: Coral anthurium, orange orchids and glossy monstera leaves in a bold asymmetric arrangement. Vibrant, contemporary and tropical. For a summer celebration or someone who loves vivid warm colors and graphic shapes.

name: Fern Reverie
description: Soft fern fronds, green hellebores and delicate white flowers in a woodland-inspired bouquet. Natural, cool and quietly textured. For a plant lover who prefers forest greens and an organic, unpolished silhouette.

name: Eucalyptus Letter
description: Silvery eucalyptus, white waxflower and a few cream roses in a loose medium bouquet. Fresh, muted and gently aromatic. For an understated thank-you or a recipient who loves soft green foliage.

name: The Monochrome Rose
description: Cream roses arranged in a dense low dome with discreet dark foliage. Refined, formal and quietly luxurious. A monochrome anniversary gift or a polished gesture for a recipient who prefers traditional symmetry.

name: Pink Architecture
description: Pink anthurium, blush orchids and folded green leaves in a spare geometric arrangement. Modern, graphic and playful. For a contemporary office or someone who enjoys architectural flowers in a soft pink palette.

name: The Desk Posy
description: A small posy of white daisies, pale yellow freesia and fresh green stems. Cheerful, unfussy and compact. A modest gift for a colleague's desk or a little encouragement during a busy working week.

name: Grand Ivory
description: An oversized arrangement of white orchids, ivory roses and full cream hydrangea. Abundant, luminous and luxurious. A major anniversary or a formal celebration where a large monochrome statement feels appropriate.

name: Petite Burgundy
description: Burgundy tulips, plum freesia and a little dark greenery in a compact hand-tied posy. Intimate, rich and understated. A small evening thank-you for someone who loves wine colors without wanting a large display.

name: A Summer Congratulations
description: Bright orange gerbera, golden sunflowers and fresh green leaves in a lively medium bouquet. Energetic, sunny and celebratory. For a sporting achievement, a graduation party or an exciting new opportunity.

name: The Mentor's Gift
description: Cream roses, blue iris and restrained eucalyptus in a polished hand-tied bouquet. Thoughtful, dignified and appreciative. A thank-you for a mentor, professor or colleague who offered meaningful guidance.

name: A Retirement Garden
description: Peach roses, lavender stock and soft summer greenery in a generous relaxed bouquet. Warm, reflective and optimistic. For a retirement celebration and the promise of slower days, gardens and new interests.

name: Welcome Back
description: Pink snapdragons, coral roses and creamy small flowers gathered into an open cheerful bouquet. Friendly, warm and informal. A welcome-home gesture after a long trip or a reunion with someone much missed.

name: A Thoughtful Remembrance
description: White lilies, cream lisianthus and restrained green stems in a graceful vertical arrangement. Peaceful, formal and respectful. A sample sympathy composition for remembrance, with a soft white palette and no bright contrasts.

name: Quiet Companionship
description: Pale cream roses, soft mauve lisianthus and gentle garden greenery in a small loose bouquet. Comforting, tender and unassuming. A supportive gesture for someone going through a difficult time, without celebratory styling.

name: In Gentle Memory
description: White anemones, silvery foliage and pale blue delphinium in an airy medium bouquet. Reflective, cool and serene. A sensitive remembrance gift for someone who finds comfort in blue and white flowers.

name: A Berry Table
description: Plum dahlias, burgundy roses and dark berry-toned accents in a low abundant arrangement. Rich, lush and intimate. A sample dinner centerpiece for an autumn evening with a deep wine-colored palette.

name: Peach Linen
description: Peach ranunculus, ivory sweet peas and delicate green stems arranged low and loosely. Soft, warm and airy. A sample centerpiece for a relaxed lunch, pale linens and a small welcoming table.

name: The Blue Celebration
description: Royal blue delphinium, white roses and cool green foliage in a tall celebratory bouquet. Confident, crisp and elegant. A graduation or professional milestone gift for a recipient who specifically loves blue flowers.

name: Champagne Congratulations
description: Champagne roses, cream orchids and pale gold accents in a polished medium arrangement. Refined, warm and celebratory. For a graduation, an award or a successful new venture, without bold primary colors.

name: Lush Apricot Garden
description: Full apricot peonies, peach roses, honey-colored dahlias and flowing foliage. Lush, abundant and warmly romantic in a generous hand-tied bouquet. For someone seeking soft warm colors and layered garden textures.

name: Copper Velvet
description: Copper chrysanthemums, terracotta roses and deep burgundy accents arranged in rich close layers. Warm, velvety and dramatic. An autumn birthday or evening gift for someone who wants earthy warmth with dark floral depth.

name: A Lemon Thank-You
description: Lemon ranunculus, yellow freesia and little white daisies in a petite cheerful posy. Bright, friendly and lightly fragrant. A simple thank-you with a sunny yellow palette rather than a large formal statement.

name: The Modern Milestone
description: White anthurium, green orchids and silver eucalyptus in a spare sculptural arrangement. Contemporary, composed and confident. For a promotion, a business opening or a graduation gift with an architectural rather than garden style.

name: A Rose-Colored Reunion
description: Dusty pink roses, mauve sweet peas and pale cream flowers in a soft rounded bouquet. Affectionate, nostalgic and gentle. A reunion with a close friend or a tender gesture celebrating time spent together.

name: Golden Horizon
description: Golden roses, amber dahlias and warm peach accents with abundant garden greenery. Lush, optimistic and radiant. For a graduation, a retirement or an important new chapter celebrated with warm generous flowers.
